description: Search the web with Tavily and return ranked results, optionally with an AI-generated answer and raw page content.

days.description: Number of days back from today to search, for the news topic.

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to exclude from the results.

include_answer.description: Whether to include an AI-generated answer summarising the results.

include_domains.description: List of domains to restrict results to; only results from these domains are returned.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to include the cleaned raw page content for each result.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

query.description: The search query to run against the web.

search_depth.description: Search depth: "basic" or "advanced". Unset lets the service choose.

name: tavily-search
